description: Oostpoort is Delft's remaining city gate, spanning a canal. Two brick towers turn octagonal near the top and carry slender spires. A smaller water gate sits at a right angle, joined by a short wall. The sky is overcast, about 16.4°C, with wind near 7.6 km/h. The Markt and the Oude Kerk are other places and are not in this frame.
